articles.title: How Stellar became part of DTCC's tokenization push for Wall Street securities onchain
articles.snippet: Wall Street's clearing giant chose a public blockchain with compliance tools built for regulated assets, Stellar Development Foundation CEO Denelle Dixon said.

articles.title: XRP Ledger's new proposal blocks the flash loan attacks costing DeFi hundreds of millions
articles.snippet: A draft XRPL amendment notes that flash loan attacks are "structurally impossible" on the network because of how its transactions are built, an architectural quirk that has spared the chain from the exploit class that has cost Ethereum DeFi billions.

articles.title: U.S. says it seized about $1 billion in Iranian crypto as pressure campaign expands
articles.snippet: The seizure, falling under "Operation Economic Fury," aims to restrict Iran's access to overseas revenue, banking networks, and crypto infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether, XRP, dogecoin lag a nine-week stocks rally as ETF demand cools
articles.snippet: The S&P 500 posted its longest weekly winning streak since 2023 and Brent oil stabilized near $92 on US-Iran ceasefire hopes. The biggest cryptocurrencies still drifted lower, with Hyperliquid's HYPE the only major name to rally.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin shrugs off early decline, but two-month winning streak is in jeopardy
articles.snippet: A hopeful posting on Iran from President Trump helped erase morning losses.
